title.zh: 速率均匀性：平均值不能代表整片
title.en: Rate uniformity: the average cannot represent the entire wafer

subtitle.zh: 平均去除率/片内分布/边缘排除区/图形密度
subtitle.en: Average removal rate / within-wafer distribution / edge exclusion / pattern density

body.zh: 去除率描述平均速度，均匀性描述空间分布，两者不能互相替代
body.en: Removal rate describes average speed; uniformity describes spatial distribution. They are not interchangeable.

body.zh: 平均相同，但空间分布不同；平均去除率：相同；平均去除率：相同；平均去除率：相同
body.en: Equal averages, different spatial distributions Same average removal rate Same average removal rate Same average removal rate

body.zh: 分布均匀；全片一致性好
body.en: Uniform distribution Good wafer-wide consistency

body.zh: 中心偏快；中心去除率高；边缘偏低
body.en: Center-fast High removal rate at center Lower at edge

body.zh: 边缘偏快；边缘去除率高；中心偏低
body.en: Edge-fast High removal rate at edge Lower at center

body.zh: 中心到边缘径向曲线；分布均匀；中心偏快；边缘偏快；去除率；（相对值）；中心；边缘
body.en: Center-to-edge radial curves Uniform distribution Center-fast Edge-fast Removal rate (relative value) Center Edge

body.zh: CMP工艺流程；建立基准；确认目标膜厚；与基准状态
body.en: CMP process flow Establish a baseline Confirm target thickness and baseline condition

body.zh: 采集中心至边缘数据；多点膜厚量测；覆盖全片
body.en: Collect center-to-edge data Measure thickness at multiple points covering the wafer

body.zh: 计算速率分布；得到片内去除率；分布与均匀性
body.en: Calculate the rate distribution Determine within-wafer removal-rate distribution and uniformity

body.zh: 对照设备与耗材；分析设备状态、；抛光垫与浆料影响
body.en: Compare equipment and consumables Analyze equipment condition, pad and slurry effects

body.zh: 调整控制窗口；优化压力、速度、；浆料流量等参数
body.en: Adjust the control window Optimize pressure, speed, slurry flow and related parameters

body.zh: SPC跟踪；持续监控趋势；保证工艺稳定
body.en: Track SPC Continuously monitor trends to maintain process stability

body.zh: 图形密度导致局部差异；低密度区；高密度区；从上方看（局部）；去除率较快；去除率较慢；图形密度影响；局部去除率
body.en: Pattern density causes local differences Low-density region High-density region Local top view Faster removal Slower removal Pattern density affects local removal rate

body.zh: 关键控制项；平均去除率；整体速率；决定吞吐
body.en: Key controls Average removal rate Overall rate determines throughput

body.zh: 片内非均匀性；全片/分区；差异评估
body.en: Within-wafer nonuniformity Whole-wafer / zonal difference assessment

body.zh: 边缘排除区；剔除不稳定；边缘数据
body.en: Edge exclusion Exclude unstable edge data

body.zh: 局部图形密度响应；不同图形区域；去除率差异
body.en: Local pattern-density response Different patterned regions Removal-rate differences

body.zh: 耦合关系：提升速率可能放大非均匀性；可能放大；整体速率提升；吞吐增加
body.en: Coupling: higher rate can amplify nonuniformity May amplify Higher overall rate Higher throughput

body.zh: 局部压力；差异；温度；差异；浆料输运；差异
body.en: Local pressure differences Temperature differences Slurry transport differences

body.zh: 常见失效模式；中心厚边缘薄；中心去除不足；边缘过度去除
body.en: Common failure patterns Thick center, thin edge Insufficient center removal Excessive edge removal

body.zh: 边缘厚中心薄；边缘去除不足；中心过度去除
body.en: Thick edge, thin center Insufficient edge removal Excessive center removal

body.zh: 局部残膜；颗粒 / 微区；去除不充分
body.en: Local residual film Particles / local regions Incomplete removal

body.zh: 批次漂移；不同批次；分布差异大
body.en: Lot-to-lot drift Different lots Large distribution differences

body.zh: 量测反馈：多点膜厚 / 晶圆map/ 分区趋势 / SPC；多点膜厚量测；晶圆map；分区趋势；SPC持续监控
body.en: Metrology feedback: multi-point thickness / wafer map / zonal trends / SPC Multi-point thickness measurement Wafer map Zonal trends Continuous SPC monitoring

body.zh: 下游影响；影响光刻焦深；CD与成像窗口
body.en: Downstream impact Affects lithographic depth of focus CD and imaging window

body.zh: 影响互连电阻；导电性能
body.en: Affects interconnect resistance Electrical conduction

body.zh: 影响刻蚀停层；层厚精度
body.en: Affects etch stop layer Layer-thickness accuracy

body.zh: 影响器件一致性；良率与可靠性
body.en: Affects device consistency Yield and reliability

body.zh: 关键边界；适用窗口；不是；全范围线性；压力/速度；压力—速度关系只适用于有限窗口，；不是全范围线性定律
body.en: Key boundary Applicable window Not linear over the full range Pressure / speed The pressure-speed relation applies only within a limited window; it is not a full-range linear law.

body.zh: 去除率
body.en: Removal rate
